# Can Compiler Explorer host #3943's repro?  Measured, not assumed.
# probe: POST https://godbolt.org/api/compiler/<id>/compile   lang=hlsl
# args:  -T ps_6_0 -E main -I inc

=== as-filed multi-file repro (repro.hlsl verbatim) -- dxc_trunk ===
--- source ---
  // #3943 -- one header, reached by two different spellings of its path.
  //
  //   "inc/common.h"  resolves relative to this file's own directory
  //   "common.h"      resolves through the -I inc search path
  //
  // Both name the same physical file. `#pragma once` in that file should suppress
  // the second inclusion. The issue reports that it does not, so CommonValue()
  // gets defined twice.
  #include "inc/common.h"
  #include "common.h"
  
  float4 main() : SV_Target { return CommonValue(); }
--- exit: 5 ---
  <source>:9:10: fatal error: 'inc/common.h' file not found
  #include "inc/common.h"
           ^
  
  <Compilation failed>

=== single-file FOLD, two spellings -- dxc_trunk ===
--- source ---
  // FOLD, mismatched spellings: the pane's own source includes itself
  // twice under two spellings. This is the transformation under test.
  #pragma once
  #include "<source>"
  #include "./<source>"
  float CommonValue() { return 1.0f; }
  float4 main() : SV_Target { return CommonValue(); }
--- exit: 5 ---
  <source>:3:9: warning: #pragma once in main file
  #pragma once
          ^
  <source>:4:10: fatal error: '<source>' file not found
  #include "<source>"
           ^
  
  <Compilation failed>

=== single-file FOLD CONTROL, matched spellings -- dxc_trunk ===
--- source ---
  // CONTROL for the fold: identical construction, but both spellings
  // MATCH. If `#pragma once` worked in the main file this must compile,
  // and the fold above would be a fair restatement of #3943. If this
  // fails too, the fold is measuring a different rule and must not be
  // published as a repro.
  #pragma once
  #include "<source>"
  #include "<source>"
  float CommonValue() { return 1.0f; }
  float4 main() : SV_Target { return CommonValue(); }
--- exit: 5 ---
  <source>:6:9: warning: #pragma once in main file
  #pragma once
          ^
  <source>:7:10: fatal error: '<source>' file not found
  #include "<source>"
           ^
  
  <Compilation failed>
